description: Enable or disable account-wide anti-download protection (GET/PUT /block_download). Reads the current state first and only changes it if needed. Turning it on is only for plans that include it (Gold/Enterprise and others; Silver/Bronze need the "Anti-Download Simples" add-on, contracted in the dashboard; not available on Clipador/Clipper and VSL Only plans). Turning it off also turns Exclusive Playback off; a paid add-on stays billed until it is removed in the dashboard. dry_run=true (default) previews the change.
name: panda_action_set_anti_download
title: Set Anti-Download Protection
